sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Medrecord-CLIP: enhancing fundus disease diagnosis via EHR-guided vision-language pre-training》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】While existing Vision-Language Pre-training (VLP) frameworks have explored text-based supervision, they frequently overlook individualized patient contexts within Electronic Health Records (EHRs).

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Leveraging this resource, we propose MedRecord-CLIP, a knowledge-enhanced foundation model featuring a diagnosis-guided cross-attention mechanism to adaptively extract and fuse salient patient history with diagnostic representations.

evidence.text: While existing Vision-Language Pre-training (VLP) frameworks have explored text-based supervision, they frequently overlook individualized patient contexts within Electronic Health Records (EHRs).

Leveraging this resource, we propose MedRecord-CLIP, a knowledge-enhanced foundation model featuring a diagnosis-guided cross-attention mechanism to adaptively extract and fuse salient patient history with diagnostic representations.
